Gramlot 0.2.11 publishes the 0.2.10 runtime on JSR as well.

## What changes

- The typings of `Gramlot.window` and `Gramlot.pagehide` use `DomWindow` and `DomEvent`, new loose DOM names of `dom.d.ts` like `DomDocument`. 0.2.10 named the DOM library types `Window` and `PageTransitionEvent`, which JSR does not load, so 0.2.10 reached PyPI and npm but not JSR.
- No runtime change from 0.2.10.

## Upgrading from 0.2.10

- No change. From 0.2.9 on JSR, read the 0.2.10 release notes: the members of `Gramlot` moved to the proxies `src`, `rpc`, `dom`, `utl`.
